context_requirements: Expression of functional P2Y2/P2Y6 or other Gq-coupled purinergic receptors
Adequate extracellular ATP or agonist availability
Proliferative signaling for antiproliferative secondary effects
falsifiers: No induction of FOS, JUN, EGR1 or other immediate-early genes at 6 h in any responsive line
No change in proliferation or cell-cycle gene expression at 24 h
Responses identical across all nine lines regardless of purinergic receptor expression
No transcriptional response at either time point in any line

changes: Removed generic proliferation/stress genes from proximal lists: MYC, CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, CDK4, CDK6, E2F2, PCNA, MCM3, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, UBE2C, CDC20, CDKN1A, GADD45A, GADD45B, SQSTM1, HMOX1, DDIT4, SESN1, TRIB3, CHAC1, ATF5, CEBPD, SERPINE1, ICAM1, TIMP2, CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, PLK1, KIF20A, KIF2C, NUSAP1, STMN1, MELK, MYBL2, BUB1B; these are secondary/generic effects, not proximal purinergic receptor signaling.
